parameters.query:
with found as (
  select token, expires_at, consumed_at
  from public.demo_invites
  where token = $1
),
redeemed as (
  update public.demo_invites
  set consumed_at = now(),
      chat_id = $2,
      user_id = $3
  where token = $1
    and consumed_at is null
    and expires_at > now()
  returning token
),
allowed as (
  insert into public.allowed_chats (chat_id, user_id, expires_at, last_seen_at, is_active, role)
  select $2, $3, now() + interval '24 hours', now(), true, coalesce((select role from public.allowed_chats where chat_id = $2), 'user')
  where exists (select 1 from redeemed)
  on conflict (chat_id) do update
  set user_id = excluded.user_id,
      expires_at = now() + interval '24 hours',
      last_seen_at = now(),
      is_active = true
  returning chat_id
)
select
  case
    when not exists (select 1 from found) then 'NOT_FOUND'
    when (select expires_at from found) <= now() then 'EXPIRED'
    when (select consumed_at from found) is not null then 'USED'
    when exists (select 1 from redeemed) then 'OK'
    else 'UNKNOWN'
  end as status,
  (select count(*) from redeemed) as redeemed,
  (select count(*) from allowed) as allowed_written;

parameters.content:
Этот запрос:
- проверит, что токен существует/не использован/не истёк
- пометит used_at + привяжет chat_id
- добавит chat_id в whitelist
- вернёт статус
